_comment: Procedural planets of the 3D map (planets3d.ts): one recipe per planet, drawn after its illustration on the board and seen from above, as the map shows it. style: the surface drawing (planets3d.ts STYLES); extras: ring, moons, network, asteroids, shards, blocks, debris. Colours come from the planet's resource (palette), or from colors when given. size scales the board's disc; spin is turns per minute; craterScale and param tune a style; bite [x, y, z, depth] cuts a chunk out of the planet towards that direction (depth: 0..1 of the radius); atmosphere: a glow at the rim, of the palette's line or accent colour. axis [x, y, z]: the axis the planet turns about, in its own space (y is towards the map's viewer); without one a planet with a bite turns about the bite, the others about a slightly tilted upright axis. The ring lies across its planet's axis. defaults.orbits: turns per minute of the moons, the satellite network and the asteroids around their planet (negative: the other way), unlike the planet's own spin.
